{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
data = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check if treatment arm exists
print("Arm values:", data['arm'].unique())

# Check responded coding
print("Responded value counts:", data['responded'].value_counts().to_dict())

# Check sample_seq per patient for deduplication
print("Number of duplicate patient_ids:", (data['patient_id'].duplicated()).sum())

# Check if any patient has more than one sample_seq
patient_sample_seq = data.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].nunique()
dup_patient_count = (patient_sample_seq > 1).sum()
print(f"Number of patients with multiple sample_seq entries: {dup_patient_count}")

# Summary of data
print("Shape:", data.shape)
print("Missing values:", data.isnull().sum().to_dict())"}
